summary: BCP Investment Corp filed an 8-K on September 2, 2026, reporting entry into a note purchase agreement for an additional $10.0 million of its 7.50% notes due 2029, issued under a shelf registration and consolidated with $50.0 million of existing notes. The notes are general unsecured obligations, redeemable at par plus make-whole before April 24, 2029. Proceeds will repay $10 million of LRFC 5.25% notes due 2026. This is a routine debt issuance and refinancing, not a special situation.
